name: RealVisXL V4.0
summary: A photorealistic Stable Diffusion XL model: portraits, people and natural light.
details: A Stable Diffusion XL checkpoint tuned for photographic realism at about 1024 pixels. A step up in realism and resolution from Stable Diffusion 1.5, at a larger size and a higher memory need. Atlas uses it through the same ComfyUI generation as any checkpoint.
